notes.title: Summer Update – Big Content Update v1.2
notes.notes:
Hey everyone!

Exciting news! The Summer Update v1.2 is live with new weapons, a new map, an Easter Egg, new features, Summer Event camos, gameplay improvements, and bug fixes!
To celebrate, we’re launching a 34% discount on the game — available for a limited time, so grab it while it lasts!

Patch Notes

https://i.imgur.com/8uAXRQU.jpeg

New Weapons

GX-5 (SMG) – Primary
Unlocked by eliminating 3,500 zombies
Fire Rate: 765 RPM
Damage per bullet: 42
https://i.imgur.com/2rWlcfp.png
Plasma Shotgun – 40 Watt (Secondary)
Unlocked by eliminating 2,000 zombies
Fire Rate: 252 RPM
Damage per pellet: 60
Pellets per shot: 4
https://i.imgur.com/xPb5J2t.png
Golf Club (Melee)
Acquirable only in-game. Unlocked by completing the Easter Egg on Gravesend (then it spawns on the green) or can be purchased for 150,000 points on other maps.
Has double the range of the Knife and deals 50x damage.


https://i.imgur.com/sFdSTo6.png

NEW Map & Easter Egg (Camo Reward)

Gravesend (New Map)
A luxurious old house with a private golf course, set in the forest, offering intense indoor and outdoor zombie battles in a unique and atmospheric environment!

https://i.imgur.com/gZLWRRe.jpeg

Easter Egg
With the new map comes an Easter Egg challenge. Completing it unlocks the exclusive Gravesend Easter Egg Camo as a reward, and the Golf Club will spawn for free on the green.

https://i.imgur.com/SyyQ6AB.png

New Features


Doors
To add more diversity and strategy, doors have been added to the new Gravesend map and the Prison map. Doors can be unlocked for 1,500 points each.

https://i.imgur.com/fDiO9G1.jpeg

Aimbot Power Up
A new Power Up that activates when you aim near a zombie. For 30 seconds, it automatically targets the heads of nearby zombies, and after eliminating one, it locks onto the next automatically.


Summer Event

Celebrate the season with exclusive Summer Event challenges and unlock a set of unique animated camos! Complete the limited-time challenges to earn 6 exclusive rewards:


Find all 7 hidden watermelons: Watermelon Camo (animated)
Get 180 Fire Zombie eliminations: Root Camo Blue (animated)
Get 15 Boss Zombie eliminations: Wave Camo (animated)
Find all 7 hidden flip-flops: Palm Tree Camo (animated)
Get 2,500 Zombie eliminations: Leopard Camo (animated)


Complete all challenges to unlock the Master Reward:

Summer Event Master Camo (animated)


https://i.imgur.com/JbKLeuf.png

Make sure to complete all challenges before the event ends on September 4th! A dedicated Summer Event widget has been added to the main and pause menus for easy progress tracking.

Gameplay Improvements & Bug Fixes
General

 Added the new weapons to the loot pool, firing range, and random weapon machines.
 Added the Golf Club as a purchasable melee weapon (except on Gravesend) for 150,000 points.
 The "Boom" Power Up no longer kills Boss Zombies.
 Reduced max. number of simultaneous zombie audio instances from 9 to 7.
 Improved ORM materials on Prison walls and overall lighting quality.
 Added doors to the Prison and Gravesend maps.
 Adjusted ADS FOV curve from linear to S-curve for smoother aiming.
 Distance Field Shadows are now also active with medium shadow settings.
 Added a green outline to indicate when event challenges are completed.
 Added Steam and in-game leaderboards for the new Gravesend map.


Bug Fixes

 Fixed some incorrect animations for VX-47 and Armax A-16 weapons.
 Fixed several spots on the Bridge, Airbase, and Prison maps where zombies could get stuck.
 Fixed a bug causing fire zombies to stop following players after being downed.
 Fixed a bug where the click sound played too often when opening the settings menu.

Enjoy the game!

notes.title: Hotfix v1.1.2 - Master Challenge
notes.notes:
Fixed an issue where the Master Challenge would not unlock.
 Reduced hitmarker sound concurrency from 3 to 2.
 Added new sound concurrency settings for impact sounds.
 Changed the credits scene animation curve from cubic to linear.
 Fixed a spot on the Airbase Hangar map where zombies could get stuck.
 Introduced a new avoidance technique to prevent zombies from getting too close to each other.

notes.title: Hotfix v1.1.1 - Master Rewards
notes.notes:
Fixed an issue where the Event Master Camo and Charm were unlocked earlier than intended.
 Fixed an issue where the in-game unlock popup for Master Rewards did not appear upon completion.

notes.title: Spring Event - Content Update v1.1
notes.notes:
Hey everyone!

Thank you so much to everyone who has played Deadzone Haunt so far! It's been an amazing first week, and I truly appreciate all the support and feedback. To celebrate the release, the first in-game event is now live, with exciting new content waiting for you to unlock!

Just as a reminder: Today is also the last day of the introduction offer — don’t miss out on the discounted price.

Patch Notes

Spring Event (May 1st – June 6th)
Celebrate the season with the first in-game event — available from May 1st to June 6th!

https://i.imgur.com/u1wCoKk.png
Complete a set of 4 limited-time challenges to earn 6 exclusive rewards:

 Eliminate 1,000 zombies: Tropic Camo (animated)
 Eliminate 8 boss zombies: Spring Camo (animated)
 Find all 6 hidden Easter eggs: Easter Camo (animated)
 Find all 6 hidden flowers: Mother’s Day Camo (animated)
Complete all challenges to unlock the Master Reward:

 Spring Master Camo (animated)
 Spring Master Weapon Charm
You must complete all challenges by June 6th — after that, the rewards will no longer be obtainable!

A dedicated Spring Event widget has been added to both the main menu and the pause menu, so you can easily track your progress.

General

 Changed the player starting position on the Art House map.
 Adjusted locations of some ground pickups (weapons, ammo).
 Adjusted primary/secondary ammo spawn ratio from 50%/50% to 70%/30%.
 Moved the "Use Custom Camos on Loadout Weapons" option higher in the settings menu for better accessibility.

Leaderboard

 Fixed an incorrect name for the Winter Village Classic leaderboard on Steam.
 Fixed an issue with the Perked Up leaderboard widget loading the wrong game mode on activation.
 Improved leaderboard reliability: the in-game leaderboard should now load the correct categories on first startup or after tabbing out of the game more consistently.

Aim Assist

 Reduced the aim assist sphere radius around zombies from 89 cm to 75 cm.
 Aim assist strength on controller now scales from 22% at 0m to 100% at 4.5m and beyond, allowing for quicker turning when zombies are close.

Audio

 Reduced max. number of simultaneous zombie audio instances from 11 to 9.
 Reduced overall zombie audio volume by 12.5%.
 The transition from 2D to 3D zombie audio now occurs at 1 meter instead of 2 meters.

Bug Fixes

 Fixed an issue with aiming sensitivity during the transition from hip fire to ADS when using a controller.
 Fixed a bug that prevented full-auto weapons from firing if you pressed the fire button too early after switching weapons or reloading.
 Fixed a recoil-related issue which helped resolve some stability issues.
 Fixed various spots where zombies could get stuck on the Prison, Bridge, and Bowling maps.

Enjoy the game!

notes.title: Release Date Announcement!
notes.notes:
Hey everyone,

The launch is just around the corner - Deadzone Haunt will be available on Steam on April 24, 2025! We’ve been working hard to improve the game since the demo. Our goal will always be to deliver smooth gameplay, great performance, and a visually appealing experience.

Don’t forget to save the date—April 24th! More updates will be coming soon. Thanks for being part of this journey!


https://i.imgur.com/qrm8w55.png

notes.title: Update 0.005b (Demo)
notes.notes:
Movement & Mechanics Improvements


 Reworked sliding and stim mechanics to make movement feel more fluid:


 Sliding and stims are now speed-based instead of force-based.
 Added a sliding speed curve for a more natural and realistic slide experience.
 Updated braking deceleration while sliding for smoother transitions.
 This rework also fixes an exploit where spamming slide and jump could lead to unintended speed boosts. Slide canceling remains possible.
 Stims now provide a 40% speed boost to overall movement speed for 3 seconds.
 Increased HUD animation brightness while using a stim to better reflect its effect.
 Increased stim activation sound volume by 30% for better audio feedback.


UI & Quality of Life Updates

 The Random Weapon Machine now displays the probabilities of each weapon upgrade tier above the device.
 Added a new movement setting: "Slide to Crouch"

 When disabled (default), players will automatically stand up after sliding instead of staying crouched.


Weapon Balancing

 Knife Movement Buff:

 Tactical Sprint Speed increased from 780 cm/s to 840 cm/s.
 Sprint Speed increased from 700 cm/s to 750 cm/s.

 VX-9 Fire Rate reduced from 900 RPM to 880 RPM.
 Adjusted hand sway parameters.
 Added individual recoil patterns and visual recoil for every weapon.

General

 Brightness of the Nuke Flash reduced by 40%.
 The Nuke Power-Up now grants 400 points upon activation.
 ADS Field of View adjusted from 90 to 82.5 (Non-ADS remains at 110).

Bug Fix

 Fixed a bug where single-fire weapons did not properly respect their intended fire rate.

notes.title: Update 0.004b (Demo)
notes.notes:
General:

 Added portals as the new spawn points for zombies.
 Updated lighting on the Bowling map.
 Updated default scalability settings to optimize volumetric fog performance.
 Updated icons in the Loadout tab in the main menu.

Bug Fixes:

 Addressed stability issues related to groom assets on Operator models in the main menu. Monitoring continues.

notes.title: Update 0.003b (Demo)
notes.notes:
General:

 Added 1-2-3 weapon switching for keyboard users.

 Additionally, the HUD now displays an overview of the weapons and their upgrade levels in the three slots: Primary, Secondary, and Melee. 
 Added an option to invert the Y-axis for the right stick and mouse in the settings menu.
 Decreased the frequency of Operator callouts by 10%.


Bug Fixes:

 Fixed several spots on the Bowling map where zombies could get stuck.

notes.title: Update 0.002b (Demo)
notes.notes:
Thanks to everyone who has already tried out the Deadzone Haunt demo and used the in-game feedback function. Based on this, the first update has been released, which has significantly improved looting and interacting with items.

Quality of Life Improvements:

 Significant improvements when looting weapons and interacting with perk machines.

 Now the direction in which you are looking is prioritized instead of the operator overlap when interacting
 The overlap radius of the individual objects has also been adjusted

 When interacting with perk machines, a description of the perk is now displayed to make it easier to understand.


General:

 Operator audio volume has been reduced by 25%


Bug Fixes:

 Fixed a bug where the last zombies in rounds where more than 15 zombies were alive would sometimes have no audio active.
